title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1453: Found you! (3)

section.p: Mo Duona continued his search. One target after another was cleared from his list. Just as he was about to reach the bottom of his list, a peal of laughter rang out in the sky.
“Are you thinking of stopping me? I’m He Tu! Stop dreaming!”

A large wave of death qi rippled over the sky. Two death sovereigns charged out of the entrance at the same time. While charging, He Tu roared, “Fellow sovereigns in the Death Realm, gather near the tunnel. When I activate it and pause the laws, come out and paint the world in blood!”
“Roar!”

Instantly, death qi started flooding the Devote King’s residence. He Tu and Dummy fought the Invincibles valiantly, spreading death qi everywhere. At the same time, black blood was spraying out of He Tu endlessly.
Suddenly, the Heaven Department head shouted, “Remove the blood!”
The others did as told. The air itself started burning as they suppressed the death qi and cleared the black blood. Right at that moment, the seventh level started shaking violently.
An Invincible roared, “We need more people here! Don’t allow them to enter!”

Instantly, seven or eight Invincibles started rushing toward the entrance. The sudden shaking of the level had nearly helped He Tu and Dummy break through their blockade. If the two were allowed to approach the Devote King’s residence, things could get even more troublesome.
He Tu felt somewhat regretful, but he was also pleasantly surprised at his progress. He laughed heartily and said, “I’ll be back!”
Then, he returned to the sixth level with Dummy.
At the same time.
The gate of an ancient residence had swung open. Everyone inside was waiting fearfully for the battle to end. When someone noticed the door swinging open, he roared, “Ming Ling, what are you doing—”
His consciousness ended there.

Three Sunmoons had scouted the entire building earlier. The moment the gate was swung open, they slaughtered all the nethers in the building. In less than ten seconds, only a nether Sunmoon was left standing.

Even the one who had opened the gate had died. After looting the building, the three retreated. After reaching somewhere safe, they killed the Sunmoon nether they had captured, allowing a moon to fall from the sky.
Nobody would care about the death of a Sunmoon outside these ancient residences. After all, people were still dying all over the seventh level. Nobody would suspect anything.

Both Pan Hu and Fourth Heaven were feeling quite nervous. The three continued fleeing. After a while, they finally stopped to inspect their gains. After a short moment, Pan Hu exclaimed in joy, “That was so profitable! The nethers must have gained a lot from the mansion this time.”
The nethers had gathered a large number of treasures in the mansion.

Su Yu wasn’t too concerned about the treasures. Rather, he was quite pleased at the number of corpses he had gathered. They wouldn’t fight him over the job of removing the corpses from the battleground as that was usually a job reserved for the weaklings.

With him being the one with the lowest cultivation level in the group, it was only natural for him to take that job. Additionally, his two companions were also wary of being found out through the corpses. Thus, they had been ignoring the corpses, allowing Su Yu to collect them all.

Fourth Heaven said, “He Tu is not giving up. This is good for us. He is clearly trying to open the death tunnel. All the Invincibles are occupied. They won’t be able to pay much attention to us anymore.”

Both Pan Hu and Fourth Heaven were in a good mood. Su Yu glanced at the two and wondered if he should kill them now. He did not intend to attack even more of such ancient residences. Once was enough as it would be way too easy to expose himself if he did it more.

Suddenly, his tribulation character pulsed. His expression changed slightly. What was it this time? He wanted to leave, but he was worried that leaving would bring him an even bigger trouble. But he couldn’t exactly stay either as his tribulation character was pulsing at an increasing intensity.
Finally, he coughed and said, “I’ll check and see if anyone is tailing us.”
Pan Hu and Fourth Heaven looked at his departing back without saying anything. But suddenly, their expression changed as the air around them froze.
A familiar voice rang out, “Deal with them. I’ll deal with the other guy.”
“Be careful, Prince…”
“I’ll be fine. Deal with them speedily. Don’t let anyone see this.”
“Yes!”

Pan Hu and Fourth Heaven paled. A Pseudo Invincible! Damn it! A Pseudo Invincible was targeting them! Su Yu, who had just left, cursed inwardly. He finally understood why his tribulation character was reacting. A Pseudo Invincible was targeting them. That was why. What was this?
There was even someone chasing after him. When Su Yu focused, he noted that his pursuer was quite weak…
Just then, a voice rang out in his ears, “Go faster. We need to get away from that guy first. I have something to discuss with you.”
Su Yu blanked out. Mo Duona. Was Mo Duona talking to him?

Once again, Mo Duona’s voice rang out in his ears, “That guy will need some time to deal with two seventh-stage Sunmoons. He will be busy for some time. Let’s find a suitable place and set an ambush to kill him. Are you confident you can do that? Do you have any reliable helpers for this job?”
Su Yu’s confusion grew. He replied, “Mo Duona! Why are you attacking us? There is no grudge between us!”
Mo Duona was fast, but he couldn’t catch up to Su Yu. When Mo Duona looked behind him, he saw a black dome covering a large area. That was the handiwork of the Pseudo Invincible.

Mo Duona spoke again, “I’m serious. I have something to discuss with you. It can benefit both of us. You’re the only person capable of helping me. I couldn’t look for you in the Allheaven Battlefield since I was under constant monitoring out there. This is my best opportunity to do this. Su Yu, do me this favor and you will benefit greatly. You won’t regret it.”

Su Yu blanked out. Holy shit! He was sure he hadn’t done anything to expose himself. He had been keeping a low profile. Even when he was running around killing people alongside Pan Hu, he only played the role of a little brother.
Holy shit!
How could Mo Duona still see through his disguise?

“We’re running out of time. If you must leave, we can agree to meet at a different location. Special voice transmission talismans work on this level. I can give you the frequency for the special channel. Contact me when you decide on a place to meet. The person behind me is a Pseudo Invincible with a past body. I can find a way to deal with his past body. You only need to handle his present body.”
Su Yu was stunned. What in the world was happening here?
“Mo Duona, you’re misunderstanding something…”

“Not at all.” Mo Duona said, “I checked everyone else. None of them is you. So either this is you or you’re that woman. I couldn’t find that woman, but since you chose to run, I’m certain this is you. Stop wasting time. I really have something urgent here. It will benefit you. That’s all. Be fast. That guy will be here soon.”
Su Yu was still dumbstruck. His brain felt stuck. He was sure he had not exposed himself. Holy shit!
Why? Was he so handsome? Was his handsomeness leaking out of his disguise? Was that why?
Su Yu felt so gloomy that he felt like coughing blood. Nevertheless, he still took the advice and sped off at a speed beyond what a regular third-stage Sunmoon could achieve.
Behind him, Mo Duona smiled. Sure enough, he was right. Very well. He had finally established contact with Su Yu.
“Hopefully, this will be enough to solve my problem.”
Before long, the shadow arrived with two balls of light in hand. The shadow asked, “Prince, did he escape?”
“Yeah.” Mo Duona said, “It’s fine. I let him go. I’m aiming for Dao Cheng. He will be my bait. Can you handle Taihe?”
“Yes, but the fight might cause quite a commotion. After all, Taihe is a ninth-stage Sunmoon.”
Mo Duona said, “It’s fine. I only need you to keep him busy. Dao Cheng’s character will be very useful for me. I need it. This will also be a good chance to cripple him before he can grow more.”
“I will follow your orders, Prince.”

Inwardly, the shadow was very confused. Why did Mo Duona not attack Dao Cheng directly? What was the point of doing this through Ling Heng? Wasn’t this pointless? Then again, he wasn’t too worried. With two seventh-stage Sunmoon immortals gone, Dao Cheng would be much easier to handle.
“Prince, is Dao Cheng’s character that useful?”
“You will know soon.”
The shadow decided to stop asking.

However, he still believed that Mo Duona was making a big deal out of nothing. If even Dao King was in such desperate straits, what could a mere Dao Cheng do? There was no need for them to pay Dao Cheng that much attention.
